title: Perimetric Contractions and Their Iterates in Complete $b$-Metric Spaces
summary: In this paper, the structural and operator-theoretic properties of contracting perimeters of triangles mapping (CPTM) within the generalized topological framework of complete $b$-metric spaces with coefficient $s \geq 1$, is systematically investigated. Extending recent foundational advancements from classical metric spaces, we explore the architectural interplay between multi-point perimetric constraints and path-wise orbital stability under two distinct structural framework.
